profile.name: 质量流量控制器
profile.description: MKS 质量流量控制器（MFC）用于测量并调节工艺气体流量，通常以 sccm 为单位进行设定。它常见于真空系统、薄膜沉积、气体混合及其他实验室气路中，用于实现稳定、可重复的供气控制。
profile.description_en: An MKS mass flow controller (MFC) measures and regulates the flow of process gases, typically using setpoints in sccm. It is commonly used in vacuum systems, thin-film deposition, gas mixing, and other laboratory gas lines to provide stable and repeatable gas delivery.
